Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Jamall Porter, is an American rapper, songwriter, entertainer, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. Born on January 20, 1997, Blueface rose to fame in 2018 after his breakout song “Respect My Cryppin’” went viral. He later became a mainstream sensation with his 2019 hit single “Thotiana,” which gained even more attention through remixes featuring Cardi B and YG.

Known for his unconventional rap flow, outspoken personality, and unpredictable social media presence, Blueface quickly became one of the most recognizable figures in West Coast hip-hop. Beyond music, he has built a massive following through livestreaming, reality television, boxing, and viral internet moments.

Blueface’s personal life has also attracted significant attention, particularly his highly publicized relationships with Chrisean Rock, Jaidyn Alexis, and Nevaeh Akira. He is a father of four children, including Javaughn and Journey with Jaidyn Alexis, Chrisean Jr. with Chrisean Rock, and his youngest son, Johnathan Jr., with Nevaeh Akira.

In 2026, Blueface continued making headlines through his livestreams, relationships, and family life. Following another public breakup with Chrisean Rock in October, he recently reunited with Nevaeh Akira and their newborn son, bringing another unexpected chapter to his ongoing story.
